proposition: MK grants one point in the apologies as genuinely Ibn Turka's: his disapproval of Muʿtazili theology, since a created Quran contradicts his lettrism; he cites his censure of Zamakhsharī in the Mafāḥiṣ, so this is a case where an apology and a doctrinal work agree.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, The Quest for a Universal Science (Yale 2012)
